daymet.message: Daymet covers North America only, and this point is outside it. The Daymet service replied that no tile exists for these coordinates, so there is no ground-station comparison here.

source.name: Daymet V4 R1 (ORNL DAAC), 1 km grid interpolated from ground weather stations
source.citation: Thornton, M.M., R. Shrestha, Y. Wei, P.E. Thornton, S.-C. Kao, and B.E. Wilson. 2022. Daymet: Daily Surface Weather Data on a 1-km Grid for North America, Version 4 R1. ORNL DAAC, Oak Ridge, Tennessee, USA. https://doi.org/10.3334/ORNLDAAC/2129
source.terms: Openly shared without restriction under EOSDIS data use guidance; citation requested.

gauge.message: CoCoRaHS is a network of volunteer rain gauges in the United States, Canada and a few other places. No station is configured for this place.

source.name: CoCoRaHS (Community Collaborative Rain, Hail and Snow Network) volunteer rain gauge
source.citation: CoCoRaHS, Colorado Climate Center, Colorado State University. https://www.cocorahs.org (data: data.cocorahs.org export service)
source.terms: CC BY 4.0 unless noted; acknowledge CoCoRaHS as the source when displaying data. Provided with no guarantee.

cdl.message: The Cropland Data Layer service answered 'Failed to get value' for this point. It covers the continental United States only, so there is no satellite crop history here.

source.name: USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer (30 m satellite classification)
source.citation: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service Cropland Data Layer. Published crop-specific data layer. USDA-NASS, Washington, DC. https://nassgeodata.gmu.edu/CropScape/
source.terms: Public domain, provided as is; NASS does not warrant conclusions drawn from the data and users are solely responsible for interpretations.

nlcd.message: NLCD 2021 (continental US) returned no pixel for this point, which is outside its coverage.

source.name: NLCD 2021 Land Cover (MRLC / USGS), 30 m
source.citation: Multi-Resolution Land Characteristics (MRLC) Consortium, National Land Cover Database 2021 (USGS). https://www.mrlc.gov. Class names from the official NLCD class legend on mrlc.gov.
source.terms: US government data, public. The exact dataset citation text was not verified from a page opened in this build.

wells.message: USGS NWIS lists no groundwater wells within about 22 km of this point (NWIS covers the United States and its territories).

source.name: USGS National Water Information System, field measurements of depth to water (parameter 72019)
source.citation: U.S. Geological Survey, USGS Water Data APIs (OGC API), field-measurements collection. https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v0/
